actions.action: Push a finger 5 cm into the soil to check moisture
If soil stays wet for days, wait longer between waterings
Make sure each pot has a drainage hole
If the white unit is a radiator, move the plant at least a meter away
Water slowly until it drains when top 3-5 cm is dry, then empty the saucer
Move plant to the brightest spot available
Keep leaves from touching cold window glass
Trim leaves that turn mostly brown at the base

reason: The answer correctly leads with repotting/transplant shock but treats the cold window only as a passing precaution rather than a cause; its advice to leave the plant alone and keep it off cold glass matches the fix, and nothing it suggests is harmful.
